entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Apparently the police are[n]going to be interrogating[n]all of the students here.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The police are at Shujin?[n]They haven't come to my school.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It seems they're calling[n]students individually out[n]of class to speak with them.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait... Does that mean we're[n]gonna get called in too!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Second-years will start in the[n]afternoon. Make sure you prepare[n]yourselves mentally for this.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: They've gotta be looking for[n]the culprit, right...?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Be careful, guys. You should[n]probably try to not say much.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: They'll see through any lies[n]you might try telling.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: In any case, don't tell them[n]anything unnecessary.
